text:
2. 1. 7

Sotāpanna suttaṃ

166. Sāvatthiyaṃ:

Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ rādhaṃ bhagavā etadavoca: pañcime rādha, upādānakkhandhā. Katame pañca, seyyathīdaṃ: rūpūpādānakkhandho vedanūpādānakkhandho saññūpādānakkhandho saṃkhārūpādānakkhandho viññāṇūpādānakkhandho, 

 yato kho rādha, ariyasāvako imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ samudayaṃ ca atthaṃgamañca assadaṃ ca ādīnavaṃ ca nissaraṇaṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ vuccati rādha, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
